\s*Vì vấn đề nội dung[\s\S]*?<\/p>/g,"").trim(); return ctx.utils.sanitize(data); }, async extractMetadata(ctx){ const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(ctx.html,'text/html'); const t=function(sel){ const x=doc.querySelector(sel); return x?ctx.utils.cleanText(x.textContent||''):''; }; const og=function(p){ const x=doc.querySelector('meta[property="'+p+'"]'); return x?(x.getAttribute('content')||''):''; }; const desc=doc.querySelector('#book-sumary'); return { title: t('#book_name2')||og('og:title'), author: t('i.cap h2'), cover: og('og:image'), description: desc?ctx.utils.sanitize(desc.innerHTML):og('og:description') }; } })

description: sangtacviet.vip — Vietnamese MTL. Requires Force Hybrid Mode. ToC from getchapterlist AJAX and chapter body from readchapter AJAX — both Referer-gated, so ctx.fetch must run in-tab (same-origin) to carry the Referer. extractChapter fetches readchapter (GET) and flattens the <i> translation tokens.
